assertions.subject: CCHDs
assertions.quote: About 75% of babies born with a CCHD are expected to survive to 1 year of age.

assertions.subject: critical CHDs
assertions.quote: About 69% of babies born with critical CHDs are expected to survive to 18 years of age.

assertions.quote: Children with CCHD are at an increased risk for developmental delay and disability, heart rhythm disorders, heart failure

assertions.subject: CCHD
